Species table aggregated across a set of cells

Source: R/calc.R
species_for_cells.Rd

Returns a tibble with one row per species, aggregated across the supplied cell set with pct_covered weighting. Works against both the v7 and v8 schemas — the differing column names (is_ok/is_valid_usa, mdl_seq/ms_merge_key, value/val) are resolved per connection.

Usage

species_for_cells(con, cells)

Arguments

con

a DBI connection to an sdm.duckdb

cells

a tibble with cell_id and pct_covered, e.g. from cells_in_polygon()

Value

tibble, one row per species; mdl_key is the model id as character (the v7 mdl_seq or the v8 mdl_key)

Details

Use species_for_zone() instead for a whole zone (subregion / Program Area / ecoregion): it resolves the zone's cells inside the database rather than shipping hundreds of thousands of cell ids into the query.
